effect.name: Bubble Mask (Texture)
effect.description: This shader is a mask for Content Mask (Texture) and should be applied to the layer below Content. The color determines when Content should be visible or not, so use a color that you will not use in the game.
effect.author: Foxioo (Made at JayTholen's request)

parameter.name: /* Foxioo's Bubble Mask (Texture) Shader | 2026.08.25 */
parameter.description: This shader is a mask for Content Mask (Texture) and should be applied to the layer below Content. The color determines when Content should be visible or not, so use a color that you will not use in the game.

parameter.name: Mixing
parameter.description: This variable is responsible for the visibility of the effect.

parameter.name: Mask
parameter.description: The variable defines the threshold at which the alpha level determines whether the mask is visible or not.

parameter.name: Color Inner
parameter.description: The variable determines the color of the "inner" mask, i.e., when the content is to be visible, use a color that you do not use in your game.
